meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能通过 lsp 工具调用语言服务器:检查一个文件或目录的诊断错误、按行列定位符号定义、跨工作区查找引用、查看文档或工作区符号,并在执行重命名前先判断该处改名是否合法。
howto.when: 当 Codex 需要在当前工作区获取语言服务器诊断、定义、引用等能力,或要求做重命名安全检查时触发。诊断报缺少语言服务器时,先跑 lsp.status。

say.text: 用 lsp 检查一下这个目录里的错误
say.note: 返回该目录的 LSP 诊断结果

say.text: 帮我找出这个符号在整个工作区里的引用
say.note: 按文件、行、字符位置查引用

say.text: 把 foo 重命名为 bar,先检查是否安全
say.note: 先 prepare_rename 再应用编辑

howto.what_en: With this skill Claude can call lsp tools to reach language servers: check diagnostics for a file or directory, go to a symbol definition, find references, list document or workspace symbols, and check a rename is valid before applying it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or a rename safety check in the current workspace. If a server is missing, run lsp.status first.

say_en.text: Use lsp to check errors in this directory
Find all references to this symbol in the workspace
say_en.note: Looks up by file, line, character

say_en.text: Rename foo to bar, check it is safe first
